name: Alert
summary: An origin feat that adds your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative and lets you swap Initiative with an ally.

benefits.name: Initiative Proficiency
benefits.text: When you roll {ref:glossary/initiative}, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.

benefits.name: Initiative Swap
benefits.text: Immediately after you roll {ref:glossary/initiative}, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition.
